## What is on testnet now

`deployments/<network>.json` lists the vaults worth looking at, which is not
the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.

the same as everything that exists: the factory's own registry is append-only,
so a vault that was abandoned part-way stays in it and is simply left out of
the file.

| Vault             | Asset                      | State                                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `casa-heredia`    | the platform's test USDC   | `Settled` — the whole money path              |
| `torre-cartago`   | our test USDT0             | `Settled` — the same path, second asset       |
| `finca-turrialba` | the platform's test USDC   | `Funding` — the one to point `run-demo.sh` at |
| `casa-circle`     | Circle's real testnet USDC | `Funding` — waiting on the faucet             |

Nothing enforces that two vaults have different token symbols — neither the
factory nor the token checks it. For the contracts that is harmless, since each
token is its own address, but a list in Neko Pro showing the same symbol twice
is ambiguous, so the Launchpad form is the place to validate it.
